test_title: PYST 27: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only three people sit between W and Y. A sits to the immediate left of Y. No one sits to the right of B. Only two people sit between B and A. X sits to the immediate right of D. How many people sit between C and X?
solution: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. 1. Only three people sit between W and Y. 2. A sits to the immediate left of Y. 3. No one sits to the right of B. 4. Only two people sit between B and A. 5. X sits to the immediate right of D.
